title: THE SIGNAL
prompt: Forty years, one patch of sky | Every ninety seconds | The building is decommissioned
style: cinematic film still, anamorphic, dramatic contrast, moody practical lighting, rich shadows, filmic grain, high detail
line: This dish has pointed at the same patch of sky for forty years. Ninety seconds ago it heard something. It heard it again ninety seconds before that. The building was decommissioned in the spring.
